title: ConfigPanel UI Spec alignment: ObjectGrid 5-value rowHeight + comprehensive section tests + ROADMAP
body:
Completes all development tasks from the ConfigPanel UI Spec alignment issue. ObjectGrid hardcoded only 3 of 5 spec rowHeight values (`compact`/`medium`/`tall`), and test coverage for section field interactions, conditional rendering, and boundary values was incomplete.

### Changes

#### 1. ObjectGrid rowHeight — full 5-enum rendering (`ObjectGrid.tsx`)
- Extended `rowHeightMode` state, `cellClassName` styles, `cycleRowHeight` toggle, and icon mapping to cover all 5 values
  - `short`: `py-1 leading-normal` (between compact and medium)
  - `extra_tall`: `py-3.5 leading-relaxed` (beyond tall)
  - Icon mapping via object lookup: `{ compact: Rows4, short: Rows3, medium: Rows2, tall: AlignJustify, extra_tall: AlignJustify }`
- Added `Rows2` icon import for medium mode

```tsx
// Before: 3-value cycle
const cycleRowHeight = () => {
  setRowHeightMode(prev => {
    if (prev === 'compact') return 'medium';
    if (prev === 'medium') return 'tall';
    return 'compact';
  });
};

// After: full 5-value cycle
const cycleRowHeight = () => {
  setRowHeightMode(prev => {
    if (prev === 'compact') return 'short';
    if (prev === 'short') return 'medium';
    if (prev === 'medium') return 'tall';
    if (prev === 'tall') return 'extra_tall';
    return 'compact';
  });
};
```

Zod schema (`objectql.zod.ts`) already had the correct 5-value `z.enum` — no changes needed there.

#### 2. Section field Spec coverage verification & interaction tests (`ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx`)
- **Toggle interactions**: `collapseAllByDefault`, `showDescription`, `clickIntoRecordDetails`, `addDeleteRecordsInline` — all verified to trigger `onViewUpdate`
- **Conditional rendering**: Sharing visibility hidden when `sharing.enabled` is false/undefined; navigation width hidden when mode is `page`; navigation openNewTab hidden when mode is `drawer`
- **All 5 rowHeight buttons**: Click each value and verify `onViewUpdate` call
- **Boundary values**: Empty bulkActions/rowActions input, long labels (200 chars), special characters in emptyState, invalid pageSizeOptions (NaN, negative, zero filtered out)
- **Enum cycling**: All densityMode values (`compact`/`comfortable`/`spacious`), all ARIA live values (`polite`/`assertive`/`off`), sharing visibility select change
- **Conditional sub-editors**: addRecord sub-editor hidden when `addRecordViaForm` is false

#### 3. Schema-level spec alignment tests (`view-config-schema.test.tsx`)
- Accessibility section field ordering (`ariaLabel` < `ariaDescribedBy` < `ariaLive`)
- EmptyState compound field structure verification
- Switch field default conventions (`collapseAllByDefault` explicitTrue, `showDescription`/`inlineEdit` defaultOn)
- Comprehensive `visibleWhen` predicates for sharing visibility, navigation width, and navigation openNewTab

#### 4. ObjectGrid rowHeight tests (`row-height.test.tsx`)
- 14 tests: initialization for all 5 values, full 5-step cycle, label display, toggle visibility

#### 5. ROADMAP update
- Updated Phase 4 test counts
- Added Phase 5 spec alignment completion section documenting all changes

### Test Results
- 141 ViewConfigPanel tests (122 existing + 19 new)
- 72 schema tests (64 existing + 8 new)
- 186 plugin-grid tests (172 existing + 14 new)
- 894 total tests pass across 64 test files
- CodeQL: 0 security alerts

> ## 待完善开发细节

> ### 1. ObjectGrid 行高 rowHeight 枚举与渲染支持
> - [ ] ObjectGridSchema.rowHeight 从 `'compact' | 'medium' | 'tall'` 扩展为 `'compact' | 'short' | 'medium' | 'tall' | 'extra_tall'` ，但 ObjectGrid 实现（例如：packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:129, 804-808, 1031-1036）仅对 3 种进行了 hardcode，传入短值/超高值会 fallback，需增加 full 5 枚举的渲染/样式能力
> - [ ] ObjectGrid 的 Zod schema 目前无 rowHeight，需增加 rowHeight 字段对应 z.enum 保证 runtime 校验不脱节
> - [ ] 完成上述修复后需补充相关单测，确保 UI 层可用所有 rowHeight
> 
> ### 2. 各 Section 字段 Spec 全覆盖与 UI 交互互测

> - [ ] 检查协议字段条件可见/禁用/默认值等约束逻辑是否全部体现
>
